_comment: Candidates for docs/model-evaluation.md. `patch` maps a logical input to a node path in the graph, exactly as a workflow manifest does. `dialect` decides which phrasing of each battery case is sent, because a booru case sent to a natural-language model measures the dialect and not the model.

illustrious.commercialUse: permitted, with the OpenRAIL use restrictions

pony._comment_prefix: Pony is trained with a score_N quality ladder and produces noticeably worse output without it, so omitting it would measure the missing prefix rather than the model.

flux2-klein._comment_negative: The negative is still sent so the negative-bite case runs and returns its real answer rather than being skipped as assumed-zero.

sana.licence: apache-2.0 (gemma licence on the text encoder)
sana._comment: Requires city96/ComfyUI_ExtraModels on the box; ComfyUI has no native Sana nodes. Node class names below follow that pack and are unverified against a running instance -- expect to adjust on first run.
